You are working in the /testbed repository. Your goal is to fix the Streamlink plugin issue “plugins.mangomolo: error: No plugin can handle URL” for the Kuwaiti media site URLs that include the www subdomain.

Context and root cause
- The mangomolo plugin has a URL matcher for media.gov.kw which currently only matches the bare domain media.gov.kw and not the www variant.
- As a result, URLs like https://www.media.gov.kw/LiveTV.aspx and https://www.media.gov.kw/LiveTV.aspx?PanChannel=Drama are not recognized by the plugin, causing Streamlink to report “No plugin can handle URL”.
- The fix is minimal: accept an optional www subdomain in the matcher.

Requirements and constraints
- Follow these steps: write isolated tests to reproduce, locate and fix the code, validate via tests, and finally delete the tests you wrote.
- Do not modify established test modules in-place; add a separate temporary test file to isolate your changes.
- Do not commit any changes.
- Keep the fix minimal and targeted (optional www only). Broadening to arbitrary subdomains is not necessary for this task.
- Ensure no regressions by also verifying that non-www URLs still match.
- Optional: After the matcher fix, briefly sanity-check that the plugin proceeds beyond URL matching (no need for full integration/mocked HTTP unless trivial).

Step-by-step plan
1) Reproduce via isolated tests
- Create a new test module at tests/plugins/test_mangomolo_www.py.
- Import the mangomolo plugin and use the same testing style as existing tests/plugins/test_mangomolo.py (inspect that file to mirror its approach, eg. using PluginCanHandleUrl utilities or direct matcher assertions).
- Add tests that assert the plugin can handle both of these URLs:
  - https://www.media.gov.kw/LiveTV.aspx
  - https://www.media.gov.kw/LiveTV.aspx?PanChannel=Drama
- Also include a control test that asserts non-www URLs still match to avoid regressions:
  - https://media.gov.kw/LiveTV.aspx
- Run pytest on just this new file to confirm it fails initially (the matcher should not match the www URLs).

2) Locate the matcher and implement the fix
- Search for the mangomolo plugin source: src/streamlink/plugins/mangomolo.py.
- Identify the matcher for media.gov.kw. It currently looks like a regex similar to:
  - r"https?://media\\.gov\\.kw/"
- Change it to accept an optional www subdomain:
  - r"https?://(?:www\\.)?media\\.gov\\.kw/"
- Do not alter other matchers unless necessary. This is a minimal, targeted fix.
- Ensure your change preserves existing matcher names/structure so that tests referring to them (if any) remain valid.

3) Validate the fix
- Re-run pytest on tests/plugins/test_mangomolo_www.py. It should now pass, demonstrating that both www and non-www URLs are matched.
- Optionally, run pytest on the existing mangomolo plugin tests to ensure no regressions:
  - pytest tests/plugins/test_mangomolo.py

4) Optional quick sanity-check
- If feasible with existing test utilities, add a very lightweight sanity check to ensure the plugin proceeds beyond can-handle-url for a mocked page response. This is optional and should not require complex fixtures; if not straightforward, skip this.

5) Clean up
- Delete the temporary test file you created: tests/plugins/test_mangomolo_www.py.
- Run the full test suite to ensure everything still passes without your temporary tests:
  - pytest -q

Acceptance criteria
- Before the fix, the new isolated tests fail because the www URLs are not matched.
- After changing the regex to include an optional www subdomain, the isolated tests pass for both www and non-www URLs.
- No regressions in existing tests.
- Temporary tests are removed at the end, as required.

Notes
- This fix addresses the specific reported failure mode. In a real PR, you would keep the added test coverage to prevent regression, but for this task, delete the temporary tests after validation.
- Avoid broadening the matcher beyond the optional www, as this is sufficient and keeps the change minimal.
